text: REST API lets you read, create, and update pages, databases, users, comments, and more across a workspace
quote: With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages, databases, users, comments, and more.

text: Personal access tokens are user-scoped credentials for scripts, CLIs, Workers, and single-user automation tools
quote: Personal access tokens (PATs) are user-scoped tokens for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, and tools that should act as one Notion user.

text: Internal connections use a workspace-scoped static API token, ideal for custom automations and workflows
quote: Internal connections are scoped to a single workspace and use a static API token. They're ideal for custom automations and workflows

text: Connections can subscribe to real-time events like page updates, property changes, and new comments via webhooks
quote: Connections can subscribe to real-time events — like page updates, property changes, and new comments — via webhooks.

text: Public integrations authenticate via OAuth 2.0 with a chosen installation scope and must pass a Notion security review before Marketplace listing
